_comment: TEMPLATE for hand-labeling a REAL document stack. Copy this file to eval/<stack-name>/expected.json and fill it in. Read the PDFs yourself and write what a correct report MUST contain — do it BEFORE looking at any produced analysis, so the eval measures the model instead of echoing it. Never commit real condo documents; keep them in /private-samples/ (gitignored).

flags._min_amount_cad_note: OPTIONAL: dollar floor checked against the flag's headline money figure (amount_cad ?? per_unit_cad). Delete the field if the flag has no money figure.
flags.evidence_quote: VERBATIM quote from source_doc, max ~40 words. Copy-paste exactly — the runner re-verifies it against the PDF text, and a paraphrase will fail the case as stale.
title_keywords: every keyword must appear in the produced flag title (lowercased, punctuation-insensitive)
